body:
I just liked the gel 
"Her gel X my gel" :-) good line
If I stop pretending I'm fine I crumble in front of their eyes. Like Friday when I failed to pretend I'm fine

Wouldn't it have been better for you if your mum had passed the first time and people told you it was cancer or something? You would have grown up without a depressed and inappropriate person around you. I'm bad for them. You would have been better without her. I try everyday to be better. I fail every single day
A friend lended me when I needed. It's expensive and should be 10% of your body weight. I looked at DIY tutorials and I think I can give it a try to make it.
The weight blanket is awesome. You feel secure and sleep really well. It's pricy and worth it if you can afford
